goals.label: v0.3.7 DMG downloads by end of year
goals.note: Jack's real ask (2026-09-20) was launching for real by end of year, not a specific download number. The schema here only supports a downloads/leads target, so this converts that into a concrete number: current pace has slowed to ~0.54/day (8 to 15 over 13 days), which would only reach ~60 by Dec 31 on its own. 150 assumes a real push (the r/IMadeThis lead, Product Hunt, more channels) actually happens between now and then, not pure extrapolation. This number is a placeholder Jack can change any time, the real commitment is the Dec 31 date.
